title: Customizable homepage carousel
subtitle: Design + front-end build · Enterprise marketing site
problem: Marketing needed to customize homepage carousel slides by target audience without engineering involvement each time.

constraints.title: Multi-region
constraints.desc: Content needed translation support across regions

constraints.title: Third-party A/B testing
constraints.desc: Component had to integrate with an external test platform

approach: Built a slide component with configurable audience targeting, structured so copy and imagery stayed swappable per locale and per A/B variant served by the third-party platform.
result: Delivered a customizable widget, built on the third-party platform, where a marketer's custom slide overrides the existing homepage carousel.
reflection: Once marketing had the tool in hand, they ran with it — using the flexibility to create compelling, creative slides beyond what I'd initially anticipated.

title: Responsive end-equipment reference diagram
subtitle: Design + front-end build · Enterprise marketing site
problem: End-equipment diagram and related product information display was unorganized.

constraints.title: Limited viewport
constraints.desc: Especially constrained on laptop, tablet, and mobile devices

constraints.title: Dense reference content
constraints.desc: Diagram and related product listings needed to coexist on screen

approach: Built a responsive display to adapt the diagram and related product panel layout to different screen sizes.
result: Display had a better flow, making it easier for customers to find related products and reference designs.
reflection: Engineers submitting diagrams found it easier to design them based on how they'd actually display on the web page.

title: TI Product Page Redesign
subtitle: Design + Thymeleaf build · Enterprise marketing site
problem: TI's product page had a confusing layout and lacked clear navigation for customers.

constraints.title: Public information only
constraints.desc: Site was scoped to public product information, not internal documentation

constraints.title: Non-technical staff
constraints.desc: Content needed to be manageable without engineering support

approach: Built and designed the page in Thymeleaf templating purposes for easier maintenance to add new content without the need for a developer.
result: Page had a better flow, making it easier for customers to find related products and make ordering parts easier.
reflection: With the redesign, the product page is now easier to navigate and has a better flow for customers to find related products. As well as the ability to add new content without the need for a developer.

title: _REACT Task Force website redesign
subtitle: Design + WordPress build · Public sector site
problem: This task force, is an organization investigating cybercrimes like cryptocurrency scams, pig butchering scams, ID theft, and high-tech crime, that had an outdated website that needed frequent updates, but was not accessible to non-technical staff. They relied on the webmaster to update the site.

constraints.title: Public information only
constraints.desc: Site was scoped to crime-related information, not a blog

constraints.title: Non-technical staff
constraints.desc: Content needed to be manageable without engineering support

approach: Built and designed the site in WordPress so staff could have content autonomy, prototyping early layout and navigation directions with Claude to quickly compare options before finalizing the design in Figma and implementing it in WordPress.
result: With that autonomy, the task force was able to provide timely updates, news, and informative crime-related scam alerts in real time.
reflection: The task force has been excited about having the ability to control the content on the new design.
